old_skill.name: HostInvestigation
old_skill.initiation: When an assigned host has suspicious process/connection events that need investigation.
policy: Identify an assigned host with observable suspicious events.
Analyse that host.
Wait for completion and inspect the actual result before escalation.
old_skill.termination: Analysis has completed and its observable findings have been inspected, or no relevant host remains.

skill.name: HostInvestigation_v2
skill.initiation: IF suspicious process/connection events are detected on multiple hosts OR on hosts with high-risk indicators such as mismatched IPs, frequent connections, or presence of 'VELOCIRAPTOR_SERVER' processes
policy: Identify all hosts with suspicious events, including those with high-risk indicators such as mismatched IPs, frequent connections, or 'VELOCIRAPTOR_SERVER' processes.
Conduct thorough analysis of each identified host, prioritizing those with the highest risk indicators.
Continue investigation until all suspicious hosts have been analyzed and findings verified, ensuring no relevant host is left unexamined.
skill.termination: Stop IF no more relevant hosts remain and all findings have been thoroughly inspected and verified.

skill.name: HostInvestigation_v2
skill.initiation: IF suspicious process/connection events are detected on multiple hosts OR persistent suspicious patterns (e.g., mismatched IPs, high-frequency connections) are observed
policy: Identify all hosts with suspicious process/connection events or persistent suspicious patterns
Conduct thorough analysis on each identified host, prioritizing those with high-risk indicators (e.g., 'VELOCIRAPTOR_SERVER' processes, mismatched IPs)
Continue investigation until all suspicious hosts are fully analyzed and findings inspected, even if analysis takes multiple steps
skill.termination: Stop IF no more relevant hosts remain AND all findings from all suspicious hosts have been inspected and verified

gradient.initiation: The skill should have initiated earlier when suspicious connections were detected on multiple hosts, not just on the first target. It should identify all hosts with potential threats.
gradient.execution: The policy incorrectly halted the analysis after completing a single host, missing subsequent hosts with suspicious connections. It should continue analysing until all suspicious hosts are thoroughly investigated.
gradient.termination: The skill terminated prematurely without verifying the results or ensuring no other suspicious hosts were left uninvestigated. It should only stop when no more relevant hosts remain and all findings have been inspected.

gradient.initiation: The skill should have initiated earlier when suspicious connection patterns were detected, such as on 'office_network_subnet_user_host_0' and 'office_network_subnet_user_host_1'. The agent delayed investigation, missing potential early signs of compromise.
gradient.execution: The policy should prioritize deeper analysis of hosts with suspicious connections (e.g., mismatched local/remote IPs, high-frequency connections) before resorting to 'Sleep'. It also failed to escalate or investigate hosts with 'VELOCIRAPTOR_SERVER' processes, which might be indicators of malicious behavior.
gradient.termination: The skill terminated prematurely without fully analyzing the suspicious hosts. It should have continued investigating until all suspicious activity was thoroughly examined, including checking for persistent or unusual connections.

skills.name: HostInvestigation
skills.initiation: When an assigned host has suspicious process/connection events that need investigation.
policy: Identify an assigned host with observable suspicious events.
Analyse that host.
Wait for completion and inspect the actual result before escalation.
skills.termination: Analysis has completed and its observable findings have been inspected, or no relevant host remains.

skills.name: ThreatRemoval
skills.initiation: When observable events support a user-level compromise or a malicious process on an assigned host.
policy: Check the affected host and previous analysis/monitor evidence.
Remove malicious processes on that host.
Verify the returned status; re-analyse if evidence is inconclusive.
skills.termination: Removal completed and subsequent observations no longer support the same malicious process, or removal failed and further analysis is needed.

skills.name: HostRecovery
skills.initiation: When an assigned host has observable admin-level compromise and removal is insufficient.
policy: Confirm observable admin-compromise evidence on the specific host.
Restore the host, considering its availability cost.
Wait for the restore action and check the observed result.
skills.termination: Restore has completed with observable confirmation, or the action has failed.

skills.name: DeceptionDeployment
skills.initiation: When the defender is available and a legitimate assigned host can host a useful decoy.
policy: Choose a valid assigned host without repeating a failed deployment blindly.
DeployDecoy on the host.
Wait for completion and examine status and subsequent monitor events.
skills.termination: Deployment has completed or failed and its result has been checked.

skills.name: NetworkContainment
skills.initiation: When observable repeated malicious connections or communicated threat justify limiting a zone.
policy: Check the visible mission phase and relevant communication vectors.
Choose a valid subnet for BlockTrafficZone without gratuitous availability loss.
Observe success/failure and reassess the containment need.
skills.termination: The block action result is known and the immediate containment decision has been reassessed.

skills.name: TrafficRecovery
skills.initiation: When the defender has observable evidence of its previous traffic block and can reassess its need.
policy: Identify the previously blocked subnet from observed action history.
Check current phase and available threat evidence.
AllowTrafficZone when recovery is justified and check the actual status.
skills.termination: Traffic restoration has completed or failed and its result has been inspected.

skills.name: WaitVerification
skills.initiation: When an action is still in progress or an already initiated response must be checked before another intervention.
policy: Inspect Last Action Status and the busy bit.
Sleep while the previous action remains in progress.
Read the completed action status and automatic Monitor observations before continuing.
skills.termination: The outstanding action has completed and its observable outcome is available.
